title: Some polling station staff in eastern Latvia replaced over security concerns
summary_full: Several local authorities on the eastern border have been forced to make urgent changes to the staff at many polling stations. The State Security Service confirmed to the LSM Latgale editorial team on September 24 that a total of 6,000 polling station staff have been vetted across Latvia.
